title: Doubly Robust Causal Effect Estimation under Networked Interference via Targeted Learning
caption: Figure 2. Model architecture of our proposed TNet. The feature module aggregates the information of covariates of unit i and its neighbor. The generalized propensity estimator module aims to estimate individual propensity score and neighborhood propensity score respectively. The outcome estimator module aims to estimate potential outcomes of unit i. The perturbation estimator module aims to estimate ϵ(t, z) that is adapted into our estimator to achieve double robustness property.
